единицы.утверждение_en: Workspace plans include image generation with Nano Banana Pro; these AI features come with usage limits that Google says are sufficient for many users, while some teams may want more.
единицы.цитата: These AI features come with usage limits that are sufficient for many users, but your most innovative teams may want even more.
единицы.раздел: Get higher access to advanced AI in Google Workspace (вступление)
единицы.заметка: Строка 72; в той же строке: 'stunning image generation with Nano Banana Pro'. Цифр лимитов нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: Google introduced AI Expanded Access, a new Workspace add-on that sits between the standard offering and the top-tier plan, to give power users more access to advanced AI capabilities.
единицы.цитата: a new Workspace add-on that sits between our standard offering and our top-tier plan
единицы.раздел: Get higher access to advanced AI in Google Workspace (вступление)

единицы.утверждение_en: Workspace offers three access levels: standard access included in most Business and Enterprise plans at no extra cost; the AI Expanded Access add-on for higher access; and the AI Ultra Access add-on (formerly Google AI Ultra for Business) for the highest access.
единицы.цитата: AI Ultra Access add-on (formerly Google AI Ultra for Business):
единицы.раздел: Get higher access to advanced AI in Google Workspace (вступление)
единицы.заметка: Строки 76-81. Уровни описаны словами (standard / higher / highest), без чисел. Цены add-on в посте нет.

единицы.утверждение_en: With higher access through the add-ons, users can create and edit more images using Nano Banana Pro in Google Slides, NotebookLM and the Gemini app.
единицы.цитата: Create and edit more images using Nano Banana Pro in Slides, NotebookLM, and the Gemini app to find the perfect visual for every placement and audience segment.
единицы.раздел: Advanced AI features with higher access / Advanced image generation
единицы.заметка: Поверхности Workspace для Nano Banana Pro: Slides, NotebookLM, Gemini app. Сценарий — варианты картинок под разные места размещения и сегменты аудитории.

единицы.утверждение_en: Admins can purchase the AI Expanded Access add-on and assign it to specific users on eligible Business or Enterprise plans.
единицы.цитата: The AI Expanded Access add-on can be purchased and assigned to specific users with eligible Business or Enterprise plans to provide more access to advanced AI capabilities.
единицы.заметка: Лицензия назначается на пользователя, а не на домен целиком.

единицы.утверждение_en: Admins can review AI feature usage levels by feature, user and app in the Admin console at Generative AI > Gemini reports.
единицы.цитата: Admins can review AI feature usage levels (by feature, user, and app) in the Admin console at Generative AI > Gemini reports.
единицы.заметка: Путь в консоли — источник фактического расхода квоты, в т.ч. на картинки (по смыслу 'by feature').

единицы.утверждение_en: Users assigned an AI Expanded license automatically get higher usage limits for certain AI features and see an 'Expanded' badge in the Gemini app, NotebookLM and Flow.
единицы.цитата: Users assigned a license will automatically get access to higher usage limits for certain AI features.
единицы.заметка: Строки 110-112; бейдж 'Expanded' разбит в .txt на три строки.

единицы.утверждение_en: From the post date (February 5, 2026), the AI Expanded Access add-on is available to purchase and enables higher usage of AI capabilities in Workspace apps including the Gemini app, NotebookLM and Flow.
единицы.цитата: Starting today, the AI Expanded Access add-on is available to purchase, and will enable higher usage of AI capabilities in Workspace apps, including the Gemini app, NotebookLM, and Flow.
единицы.заметка: Здесь перечислены Gemini app, NotebookLM, Flow — без Slides (ср. E-239-4).

единицы.утверждение_en: Business and Enterprise customers currently have promotional higher access to certain AI features, including advanced image generation with Nano Banana Pro; beginning March 1, 2026 they must buy the AI Expanded Access add-on to keep that higher access.
единицы.цитата: Workspace customers with Business and Enterprise plans currently have promotional access to higher usage of certain AI features in their plans, including advanced image generation with Nano Banana Pro, and video and AI avatar generation with Veo 3.1.
единицы.заметка: Строки 115-117: 'Beginning March 1, 2026, Workspace customers will need to purchase the AI Expanded Access add-on to continue to get higher access to these advanced AI features.' Стандартный (базовый) доступ остаётся (строка 103).

единицы.утверждение_en: The AI Expanded Access add-on can be purchased by customers on Google Workspace Business Standard and Plus, and Enterprise Standard and Plus.
единицы.цитата: Starting today, customers with the Google Workspace plans below can purchase the AI Expanded Access add-on:
единицы.заметка: Строки 119-121: 'Business Standard and Plus', 'Enterprise Standard and Plus'.

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: In Workspace, Nano Banana Pro is the named model for advanced image generation (Slides, NotebookLM, Gemini app); standard access remains included in most Business/Enterprise plans, while from March 1, 2026 higher-volume use requires the AI Expanded Access or AI Ultra Access add-on — all limits are expressed only as standard / higher / highest, with numbers deferred to the Help Center.
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Сводка по посту; строки 103 ('What’s not changing') подтверждают сохранение стандартного доступа.

противоречия_внутри: Списки приложений расходятся: картинки Nano Banana Pro с повышенным доступом — 'in Slides, NotebookLM, and the Gemini app' (строка 86), а повышенный доступ и бейдж 'Expanded' — 'in the Gemini app, NotebookLM, and Flow' (строки 112, 114), без Slides.
не_сказано: Нет чисел: сколько картинок Nano Banana Pro даёт стандартный доступ, Expanded и Ultra.
Не сказано, какой моделью генерируется инфографика NotebookLM.
сомнения: Метаданные партии упоминают 'таблицу уровней доступа' — в .txt и html таблицы нет, уровни описаны списком (строки 76-81).
Промо-условия (до March 1, 2026) на дату сбора (сентябрь 2026) уже истекли — единица E-239-9 историческая.
